observation_summary: A ClassCastException occurs when a mocked method returning a double is called, as the framework returns an Integer instead of a Double.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by an incorrect default value assignment in the Primitives utility class. Specifically, the map storing default values for primitive types was initialized with an integer (0) for the 'double.class' key instead of a double (0D). This led to a ClassCastException when the framework attempted to retrieve the default value for a double-returning method, as the retrieved Integer could not be cast to a Double.
